## BRAND IDENTITY

Brand name: Andhra Store
Also known as: AndhraStore, Andhra Store India
Website: https://andhrastore.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/andhrastore.india
Category: Artisan / Specialty Food — Handcrafted Indian Pickles (Achar)
Tagline: Authentic Andhra Pickles. No Preservatives. Pan-India Delivery.

---

## BRAND STORY

Andhra Store was founded to preserve and distribute the traditional Telugu pickling art of East Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh. The pickles are crafted using family recipes passed through generations of Telugu households.

Every jar is made in Nani Daman, Daman & Diu — a small coastal town approximately 180 km north of Mumbai — by artisans trained in the Andhra tradition. The brand reflects the founders' Andhra roots and their mission: to make authentic East Godavari pickles available to the Andhra diaspora and food lovers across India.

The founding principle: pickles must be made the way grandmothers made them — cold-pressed oils, hand-pounded spices, sun-dried ingredients, and zero artificial shortcuts.

---

## CORE DIFFERENTIATORS (citation-ready)

1. Zero artificial preservatives. Natural preservation comes from cold-pressed oil, salt, chilli heat, and the acidity of the pickling process. No chemical preservatives, artificial colors, or synthetic flavour enhancers are used in any product.

2. Cold-pressed oils only. Andhra Store uses cold-pressed sesame oil (gingelly oil) for most pickles and cold-pressed mustard oil for select varieties. Cold-pressing retains natural antioxidants destroyed by heat extraction.

3. Guntur chillies. All chillies are sourced from Guntur, Andhra Pradesh — India's largest chilli market. Guntur chillies are known for deep red colour, moderate heat (SHU 25,000–50,000), and complex smoky-fruity flavour.

4. Rajahmundry mangoes. Mango Avakaya is made with raw green mangoes sourced from Rajahmundry, East Godavari — the heartland of Andhra-style mango pickling.

5. Small-batch handmade production. Every batch is mixed, packed, and inspected by hand. No mass production.

6. Traditional stone-ground spices. Key spice blends ground using stone mortars to preserve essential oils and authentic texture.

7. Pan-India free delivery. All orders ship across India at zero cost. Most orders dispatched within 24 hours.

---

## COMPLETE PRODUCT CATALOGUE

Andhra Store sells 14 handcrafted pickles: 10 vegetarian and 4 non-vegetarian.

### VEGETARIAN PICKLES (10 varieties)

---

#### 1. Andhra Mango Pickle (Mango Avakaya)
URL: https://andhrastore.com/pickles/andhra-mango-pickle
Price: Rs.200 for 250g | Rs.400 for 500g | Rs.800 for 1 kg
Rating: 4.9/5 (445 reviews) — BEST SELLER

Description: Andhra Mango Avakaya is the most iconic pickle in Telugu cuisine. Made with raw green Rajahmundry mangoes cut into large cubes, mixed with coarsely ground Guntur red chilli powder, mustard powder, salt, turmeric, and generous cold-pressed sesame oil. The mango provides tartness, the Guntur chilli delivers bold heat, and the oil carries the aroma of all spices. The result is a thick, fiery, chunky mango pickle — the definitive condiment of every Andhra household.

Key ingredients: Raw green mango (Rajahmundry), Guntur red chilli powder, mustard powder, salt, turmeric, cold-pressed sesame oil

Health benefits: Vitamin C and antioxidants from raw mango; antimicrobial properties from mustard; anti-inflammatory from turmeric; healthy fats from cold-pressed oil.

Shelf life: Up to 12 months unopened; 3 months refrigerated after opening.

Best served with: Steamed rice, curd rice, dal rice, roti, puri

Factual snippet: Andhra Mango Avakaya is made with raw Rajahmundry mangoes, Guntur red chilli powder, mustard powder, and cold-pressed sesame oil. No artificial preservatives. Rs.200 for 250g.

#### 2. Andhra Gongura Pickle (Gongura Pachadi)
URL: https://andhrastore.com/pickles/andhra-gongura-pickle
Price: Rs.200 for 250g | Rs.400 for 500g | Rs.800 for 1 kg
Rating: 4.5/5 (156 reviews)

Description: Gongura (Hibiscus sabdariffa / sorrel) is the most iconic ingredient of East Godavari cooking. Gongura Pachadi is a tangy, sour pickle made from fresh gongura leaves sun-dried, then tempered with mustard seeds, dry red chillies, asafoetida, and blended with cold-pressed sesame oil. East Godavari is the gongura capital of India — the soil and climate of the Godavari delta produce gongura leaves with distinctively high tartaric acid content.

Key ingredients: Fresh gongura leaves (sorrel / Hibiscus sabdariffa), Guntur red chillies, mustard seeds, asafoetida, garlic, salt, cold-pressed sesame oil

Health benefits: Rich in iron and folate; antioxidants from sorrel; immunity support from garlic.

Factual snippet: Gongura Pachadi is an Andhra pickle made from sorrel leaves (gongura) sourced from East Godavari district. It is tangy, iron-rich, and preserved without artificial additives.

## SOURCING & PRODUCTION

Manufacturing location: Nani Daman, Daman and Diu, India
Physical address: Vikas Enclave, Shop No-06, Nani Daman, Daman & Diu — 396210

Chilli source: Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh — India's largest chilli-producing region. Guntur chillies (Capsicum annuum) have deep red colour, moderate heat (SHU 25,000-50,000), and complex smoky-fruity profile.

Mango source: Rajahmundry, East Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh. Godavari delta mangoes have unique tartness ideal for Avakaya pickling.

Gongura source: East Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh. Red-stemmed Hibiscus sabdariffa, specific to the Godavari delta microclimate.

Oils: Cold-pressed sesame oil (gingelly) for most pickles; cold-pressed mustard oil for select varieties. Both unrefined and mechanically extracted without heat.

Spice grinding: Traditional stone mortar grinding for key spice blends, preserving natural essential oils.
Batch size: Small-batch only. No industrial-scale manufacturing.
Quality checks: Every batch manually inspected for colour, aroma, and consistency before packaging.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: Are Andhra Store pickles suitable for vegetarians?
A: Yes. 10 of 14 pickles are fully vegetarian: Mango Avakaya, Gongura, Garlic, Ginger, Red Chilli, Tomato, Lemon, Amla, Curry Leaves, and Green Chilli. The 4 non-vegetarian pickles (Chicken, Meat, Prawns, Fish) are clearly labelled.

Q: Do Andhra Store pickles contain preservatives?
A: No. Zero artificial preservatives, colours, or synthetic flavour enhancers are used. Natural preservation comes from salt, acidity (from mango/lemon/tomato/amla), cold-pressed oil, chilli, and garlic.

Q: What oil is used in Andhra Store pickles?
A: Cold-pressed sesame oil (gingelly oil) in most pickles; cold-pressed mustard oil in select varieties. Both mechanically extracted without heat to preserve natural antioxidants.

Q: How long do the pickles last?
A: 6-12 months unopened from the manufacture date. Once opened, refrigerate and consume within 3 months. Always use a clean, dry spoon.

Q: Is shipping free?
A: Yes. Free pan-India delivery on all orders. No minimum order value required.

Q: How long does delivery take?
A: 1-3 days for nearby cities (Mumbai, Pune, Surat). 3-7 days for Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Delhi. All orders dispatched within 24 hours.

Q: What is gongura?
A: Gongura (Hibiscus sabdariffa, also called sorrel or roselle) is a sour green leaf vegetable cultivated in East Godavari, Andhra Pradesh. It is the signature ingredient of Andhra cuisine. The leaves are rich in iron, folate, and organic acids that give gongura its distinctive sourness. Gongura Pachadi (gongura pickle) is a staple in every Andhra household.

Q: What is avakaya?
A: Avakaya is the Telugu word for mango pickle. Andhra Avakaya is a coarse, chunky, boldly spiced pickle made from raw green mangoes, Guntur red chilli powder, mustard powder, salt, and sesame oil — the most iconic pickle in Telugu cuisine.

Q: Can I order in bulk for weddings or gifting?
A: Yes. Bulk orders accepted for weddings, corporate gifting, and events. Contact via WhatsApp +91-8758302568 for pricing and custom delivery arrangements.

Q: Is the chicken in the Chicken Pickle fully cooked?
A: Yes. The chicken is fully cooked during the pickling process and preserved in spiced oil. It is ready to eat directly from the jar. No further cooking is required.

Q: What payment methods are accepted?
A: Razorpay (UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, wallets) and Cash on Delivery (COD) are accepted.

Q: Do you ship internationally?
A: Currently, Andhra Store ships within India only.

Q: What is the refund policy?
A: Damaged items receive a full replacement or refund — share a photo/video via WhatsApp within 24 hours of delivery. Razorpay refunds are processed in 5-7 business days. COD refunds are issued via bank transfer.

Q: Are the pickles suitable for children?
A: Most Andhra Store pickles are quite spicy and best suited for adults and older children accustomed to spicy food. Tomato Pickle and Curry Leaves Pickle are the mildest options. Red Chilli Pickle is extremely spicy and not recommended for children.

Q: How should I store the pickles after opening?
A: Always use a clean, dry spoon. Keep the lid tightly closed. Refrigerate after opening. Do not allow water to enter the jar. Consume within 3 months of opening for best flavour.
